notes: The about page confirms Happyness only as co-founder; the 'Managing Director (Geschaeftsfuehrerin)' part of the role on record does not appear on the English about or imprint pages, so a person should confirm the title before using it. The imprint address (PO Box 15204, USA River) matches the Usa River locality on record. No staff numbers are published: the about page presents four co-founders and mentions guides. The team section is mostly the founders' personal stories, which were not recorded.
